definition: An organizational unit groups AWS accounts with common governance requirements.
An SCP limits maximum permissions for identities in organization member accounts without granting access.
An RCP limits access to supported resources in organization member accounts without granting access.
Trusted access permits a supported AWS service to perform organization-wide tasks.
A delegated administrator is a member account authorized to administer a particular service for the organization.
A service-linked role is a role that an integrated AWS service uses to perform its required tasks.
A landing zone is a governed multi-account environment managed through Control Tower.
A StackSet deploys a common CloudFormation template across selected accounts and Regions.
A stateful traffic control remembers allowed connections and permits their response traffic.
A stateless traffic control evaluates each traffic direction without remembering previous packets.
A digest file contains signed references and hashes used to validate delivered CloudTrail logs.
A finding is a report of a detected security issue.
TLS is a protocol that protects application connections using encryption and certificates.
A DDoS attack uses distributed traffic to overwhelm an application or network.
Intrusion prevention inspects network traffic for threats and can block matching traffic.
